It was once a term for the western and northern periphery of the palace. During Song Dynasty, the Minister of War resettled citizens here, dividing the district into three new wards: Prosperity Haven, Tranquil Haven, and Tidal Haven.
Today, the area south of Goldwater Street is what people call Prosperity Haven.

Did you get the recipe I sent you? I realized I missed a line: adding plum while cooking helps get rid of any strong flavors in the broth. The timing and proportions can be a bit tricky... The moon we admired together that night was truly the most beautiful I've seen in all these years.
